notes: Ford publishes no state-by-state jobs or investment table that was found. Its corporate.ford.com Global Offices & Plants page lists each plant with approximate employees (U.S., Canadian and Mexican plants marked "Headcount data from June 2026"; others undated; rechecked 2026-11-24 with the same figures); per-state totals are not derived from it, so selected plants appear as sites. The FY2025 10-K gives ~169,000 employees worldwide with no regional split, says Ford and consolidated entities use over 409 operations facilities across 27 countries and 42 manufacturing and assembly plants, and names joint-venture plants (e.g. Türkiye, Thailand, China) without counts. Ford's corporate economic-impact page (corporate.ford.com/social-impact/economic-impact.html) returned only site navigation in its static HTML in the earlier research (not rechecked in this refresh), so its body could not be read; no state-level U.S. investment figures were found on the Ford pages that could be read. Long-lived assets by country (Dec 31, 2025): U.S., Canada, UK, Mexico and All Other. The Saarlouis Body and Assembly Plant site was removed: the FY2025 10-K says Ford ceased Focus production there in the fourth quarter of 2025 and plans to repurpose the facility into a technical center (the plants page still lists it).
